text: Because boards and donors seek to preserve endowments rather than spend them, funds accrue tax free long after the donor has taken the deduction, which runs counter to the spirit of the rules governing charitable deductions and may contribute to harmful inefficiency.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How Decentralized Autonomous Organizations Optimize Charitable Giving (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3981021
